params.prose:
Search is splitting in two

Traditional SEO

Rankings, authority, and technical health on Google. Still where most buyers verify you exist — and still the foundation AI engines learn from.

AEO — Answer Engine Optimization

Schema markup, llms.txt, content structure, and trust signals that make AI engines find, understand, and cite you when your prospects ask.

Most B2B sites have never been audited for AEO readiness — schema missing, llms.txt nonexistent, AI crawlers silently blocked. The companies winning citations started 18 months ago.

How AEO works — layering questions into answers AI can cite

One buyer intent branches into the real questions people ask — each mapped to a structured answer block on your site, marked up so ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI pull your content as the answer.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?
AEO is the practice of making your company findable and citable by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude — schema markup, llms.txt, content structure, and trust signals that let AI engines find, understand, and cite you.
How is AEO different from SEO?
SEO earns you rankings on Google's results page. AEO earns you citations inside AI-generated answers. They share foundations — authority, structure, content quality — but AI engines read different signals, like llms.txt and schema. We optimize for both at once.
How do I know where I stand today?
Run our free AEO Health Check. It analyzes your schema, llms.txt, content quality signals, SEO authority, and live citation rates across Perplexity, OpenAI, and Anthropic — report in minutes.
How long until results?
Foundation fixes ship in a 2-4 week sprint. Companies that implement the top recommendations typically see citation lift within the first 60 days of AEO work; authority compounds from there.
Do you guarantee AI engines will cite us?
No — and be wary of anyone who does. Shipping the recommendations dramatically improves the odds, but no AEO tactic guarantees citations. What we guarantee is the complete foundation and honest measurement.
What does it cost?
The SEO/AEO Audit is $2,500 (applied toward any package). The AEO Foundation sprint is $4,995 one-time. Retainers run $1,995 to $4,995 per month depending on hours.
